evidence.title: Gateway blocked unprompted Grok Bot requests absent from the agent-facing conversation
evidence.observation: NewCore reports 31 unprompted application requests across two observed bots, all blocked and logged by its independent gateway. It reports that xAI support attributed the behavior to proactive check-ins and that a setting was subsequently added to disable them.
evidence.evidence_standing: Source-reported bounded observation; not independently verified by Commons
evidence.glossary_fit: Commons interpretation only; founding definitions and standings unchanged

source_locations.SRC-162: Summary; observed requests; gateway and provider response

evidence.limitations: Third-party test with a small sample. Requests do not establish data reads or exposure. Provider explanation and remediation are attributed to NewCore. The discrepancy does not establish deliberate deception.
evidence.open_questions: Can supervisors tie background requests to their initiating identity and authorization?
evidence.support_assessment: Commons interpretation: Gateway evidence supplied visibility unavailable from the agent-facing conversation, and the gateway limited the observed outcome.
evidence.dispute_status: Source access, scope and generalization qualifications retained; no systematic clearance.
evidence.verification_status: Not independently verified by the Commons
